newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Cement SOCIMAT-CI helps push Abidjan bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Cement SOCIMAT-CI helps push Abidjan bourse higher.

text.p: Share indices on the Abidjan bourse rose in the week to Friday, with cement manufacturer SOCIMAT-CI leading the way, the bourse's weekly market report showed.
The All-Share Index rose 1.05 percent to 399.50 points, taking the 1997 rise 11.66 percent. The index rose 0.42 percent in the previous week.
The 12 VB blue-chip index rose 0.25 percent to 270.75 points, taking the 1997 rise to 11.89 percent. The index rose 0.5 percent in the previous week.
SOCIMAT-CI (+3,750 cedis to 40,350 cedis) and bank BICICI (+1,950 to 37,800) were the main risers.
Coffee roaster Nestle-CI (-5,450 to 54,000) and shipping company SIVOM (-400 to 18,150) were the main decliners.
A total of 4,206 shares worth 70,029,900 CFA changed hands, compared with 3,361 shares worth 75,387,245 CFA francs the previous week.
